page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn8ia-m8.4xlarge is an x86_64 virtualization instance belonging to the Compute Optimized with GPU family. Built on KVM hypervisor architecture, it provides 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at 3.4 GHz. System memory totals 64.0 GB, maintaining an allocation ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is delivered by a single NVIDIA Ada Lovelace GPU equipped with 8 GB of VRAM. The instance features no local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for operating system disks and persistent file operations. Network interfaces provide a baseline bandwidth of 7 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

Architecturally, this profile balances dedicated multi-core CPU capacity with entry-level graphics processing. The 8 GB VRAM boundary limits deployment to smaller model architectures or lower-precision workloads, while the lack of local NVMe SSDs places full I/O throughput demands on network storage. Best-fit use cases include lightweight artificial intelligence inference, video transcoding, visual rendering, and graphics-accelerated processing tasks.
